code.note: Official OpenVLA repository includes model, training, fine-tuning, deployment and evaluation code.

weights.note: Official OpenVLA checkpoints and model cards are publicly released on Hugging Face.

dataset.note: Training/evaluation uses public Open X-Embodiment and BridgeData-style datasets with mixture/config guidance, but the paper's entire training corpus is not packaged as one project dataset release.

training.note: Repository documents LoRA/full fine-tuning and training-from-scratch paths with executable scripts.

inference.note: Public inference and deployment examples are provided, including Hugging Face loading and REST deployment.

evaluation.note: Repository documents benchmark/robot evaluation flows, including LIBERO and BridgeData/WidowX evaluation.

license.note: Repository code is MIT-licensed, while pretrained model use inherits restrictions from the underlying Llama-2 base model.

code.note: Official OpenVLA-OFT repository contains the fine-tuning, inference and evaluation implementation.

weights.note: README provides public pretrained/fine-tuned OpenVLA-OFT checkpoints for direct inference.

dataset.note: The repository provides benchmark-specific setup and uses external LIBERO/ALOHA data; it does not package the complete training data as a standalone project dataset release.

training.note: Fine-tuning procedures are documented for LIBERO and ALOHA with executable code.

inference.note: Quick-start inference is documented with released checkpoints and public implementation.

evaluation.note: LIBERO and ALOHA training/evaluation guides are included in the repository.

license.note: Repository code is released under the MIT License.

code.note: Physical Intelligence's openpi repository contains π0 model code, training, inference and examples.

weights.note: openpi publicly provides π0 base and multiple fine-tuned checkpoints.

dataset.note: Public examples cover DROID/LIBERO and data conversion, but the 10k+ hour base pretraining mixture is not released as one complete public dataset.

training.note: The repository provides runnable fine-tuning/training configs and scripts for π0.

inference.note: Released checkpoints can be loaded through the public policy API; local and remote inference examples are documented.

evaluation.note: Public examples include benchmark evaluation workflows such as LIBERO and robot-specific examples.

license.note: Repository code is Apache-2.0, while third-party/base-model components have additional license terms such as the included Gemma license.

training.note: openpi provides π0.5 fine-tuning configs and runnable training instructions.

inference.note: π0.5 checkpoints have public inference and policy-server examples.

evaluation.note: The repository documents π0.5 LIBERO evaluation and additional robot examples.

license.note: Repository code is Apache-2.0; model/base components include additional third-party license terms.

code.note: Official Xiaomi-Robotics-0 repository includes deployment, post-training and benchmark evaluation code.

dataset.note: Sample/post-training data paths are public, but the complete pretraining corpus is not released as a project dataset.

training.note: Post-training/fine-tuning code is released; the full original pretraining pipeline and corpus are not presented as a complete reproducible release.

code.note: Official Xiaomi-Robotics-1 repository includes post-training, deployment and benchmark evaluation code.

inference.note: Deployment/inference code is publicly available in the official repository.

evaluation.note: RoboCasa, RoboCasa365 and VLABench have repository evaluation guides/checkpoints; RoboDojo points to external official docs without a matched released checkpoint in the table.

code.note: LaWAM repository includes core model code, latent-action/world-model code, deployment, training and benchmark examples.
